description: Explicit local two-external-seat mode. Keeps original single player behavior. Both external seats use identical input, timings and recovery requests, never the built-in bot.

changes.before: isHuman(id: number) { return id === 0 || this.online || this.training !== 'off'; }
changes.after: isHuman(id: number) { return this.externalControl || id === 0 || this.online || this.training !== 'off'; }
